notes.title: The Case of the Worst Day Ever Demo Available!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is going on now and the demo for our next game, The Case of the Worst Day Ever, is now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3279410/The_Case_of_the_Worst_Day_Ever/

A family is gathered for a cozy celebration, but everyone looks miserable! What happened here? Who are these people (and pets)?! And why are they so unhappy?!?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41054136/4a179c34a49773f80b4a79e087840fb07cee7275.png[/img]
From the family dog to the grumpy grandma, peek inside their unfortunate lives and investigate the events leading up to the party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41054136/8ecaf0a3488b187139df5d869200f744921804ae.png[/img]
Scour each silly scene for clues that point to identities, motives, and misadventures. Then use your deductive skills to fill-in-the-blanks and put your conclusions to the test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41054136/c6af08aea0b99b93975f5af31d3557c8e5c78132.png[/img]
These poor people (and pets) just want someone to understand their misfortune. Uncover the mystery of the worst day ever and make everyone happy again!

Happy solving!

notes.title: Introducing POEMS & CODES - a game of poetic ciphers
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce the sequel to Prose & Codes! If you loved Prose & Codes, get ready for a brand new library of ciphers to decode -- coming later this year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295070

[list]
[*]Decode a vast and varied collection of curated poetry, where each poem is encrypted using one of the world's oldest codes: the substitution cipher
[*]Use your knowledge of the English language to decrypt over 400 interconnected excerpts, with each cipher inspiring the next to come
[*]Like what you decoded? Read the entire poem in-game or download each poet's anthology online for free, direct links included!
[*]Share the joy of poetry--10% of every sale is donated to Project Gutenberg, an online library of over 60,000 free ebooks
[*]Play at your own pace with four difficulty settings to choose from
[*]Relax with a soothing, contemplative soundtrack
[*]Choose between night or sunlight mode with optional enlarged cipher text
[/list]

We'll be sharing a demo with you this summer, so stay tuned and wishlist now!

notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available + 16 New Ciphers!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Prose & Codes now offers community items!

Collect trading cards featuring famous authors from each genre, craft book badges (plus the exclusive Gutenberg foil badge!), and decorate your profile with awesome illustrations from the game!

As an added bonus, we've included 16 brand new ciphers for you to puzzle over.

Huge thanks to everyone for your reviews, feedback, and continued interest in the game. Trading cards are a big milestone for us, and we couldn't have done it without you! :)

Happy solving!

notes.title: 2 extra Great Thinkers ciphers plus bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello! Two little updates for you today:

[list]
[*]2 more ciphers for the Great Thinkers genre, for those of you who needed 52 ;)
[*]Fixed a bug where a solved letter would be erased/not appear, making the puzzle unsolvable
[/list]

Big thanks to everyone for checking out the new update and for reporting any issues you found!

Happy solving!

notes.title: FREE Great Thinkers Update!
notes.content:
We're so excited to share a brand new genre full of 50 new ciphers: GREAT THINKERS!

Decode quotes from some of history's most influential thinkers, ranging all the way from ancient wisdom to modern philosophy. This is our first non-fiction category, and we hope you enjoy!

In addition to the new ciphers, we've added a few requested features to make your solving experience even smoother. On the cipher screen, you'll now find an UNDO button (you can also use CTRL+Z), and we've added the ability to right click on a letter to erase it. There are also minor fixes for typography spacing and typos.

Happy solving!

notes.title: Patch Notes + 14 new ciphers!
notes.content:
Hello! In today's update, we have the following:

[b]14 new ciphers![/b]
Note: if you've already finished the game, you will see the endgame screen one more time after completing these new ciphers. With future updates, the endgame screen will not trigger again.

[b]Typos[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Tanglewood Tales[/i] synopsis
[*][i]The Mystery of the Yellow Room[/i] synopsis
[*]Children's cipher #20
[*]title of [i]The Wendigo[/i]
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]added option to disable cursive handwriting font 
[*]added borderless window mode 
[*]created profile data backup folder in your local save data directory; these can be used to restore older save data if you ever need it (please see the discussion forums for instructions on how to find your save data directory)
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed endgame issue where players couldn't reveal the book title before being taken away to the endgame screen
[/list]

[b]Still in the works/Things we're considering[/b]
[list]
[*]undo button
[*]some sort of Steam cloud integration or way to make manually backing up save data easier
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes & Updates!
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you so much to everyone who gave feedback over the past two weeks. 

[b]User-Friendly Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]added a little arrow above the active letter box to make keyboard navigation easier
[*]letter boxes will now stay active when changing pages on multi-page ciphers
[*]changed "VIGNETTE" label to "FLICKER FX" on Settings screen for clarity
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]tearing noise will no longer play on click when the "Reveal Book Title & Author" ribbon is not present
[*]fixed a crash that occurred when decreasing cipher text size on multi-page ciphers
[*]changed the title of "Tales of Terror and Mystery" in the Mystery genre to "The Lost Special" to avoid duplicate book titles
[/list]

[b]Still Investigating/On the Agenda[/b]
[list]
[*]HDR monitor brightness issue
[*]considering adding an "Undo" button
[/list]

notes.title: Coming February 11th + dark mode demo update available now!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work, and we're so excited to announce the Prose & Codes release date: February 11, 2022! Get ready for all 350 ciphers--coming your way in just a few weeks!

As for the demo, you'll now find two new features in the Settings menu:
[list]
[*]a soothing dark mode
[*]an option to enlarge cipher text
[/list]
(Music additions may still be coming with the full release.)

As always, please let us know if you run into any issues or have any additional feedback!

We are extremely grateful to everyone who has helped us make this game what it is today. We couldn't have done it without you!

Happy solving! <3

notes.title: Major Demo Updates + 7 More Ciphers!
notes.content:
The release of Prose & Codes is on the horizon! While we put on the finishing touches, check out these awesome updates to the demo:

[list]
[*]a new cipher for each genre!
[*]clickable alphabet allows for mouse-only input on ciphers
[*]you can now select cipher letter boxes using the arrow keys, plus navigate through multi-page ciphers with the Page Up and Page Down keys
[*]option to play new interactive tutorial
[*]option to hide the book title & author when ciphers are solved (now hidden by default; you can change this via the Settings menu)
[*]added "Medium" difficulty option
[*]updated help screen with cipher solving tips
[*]music changes
[*]custom cursor
[*]clicking the "Entire Story" button will also copy the book URL to your clipboard (certain Linux systems will not allow the game to open a browser window automatically)
[*]tweaks to credits screen
[/list]

We're still working on final music changes and dark mode. Please let us know if you run into any issues or have any additional feedback! 

Happy solving! <3

notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello! Big thanks to everyone who reported bugs. Below are the fixes for this patch:

[list]
[*]fixed bug where boxes would not accept player input
[*]fixed bug where solving the second page of a cipher would solve the entire cipher
[*]fixed blue screen error triggered during state transitions
[*]fixed bug where solved letters would be selected upon first entering a cipher level
[*]corrected typo in The Count of Monte Cristo synopsis
[*]fixed bug where cipher page arrows did not resize properly during window resizing
[/list]

Thanks again for all the feedback, and let us know if you run into any other issues! We are still working on a few other bugs that were reported.

notes.content:
Prose & Codes is a game of literary ciphers in support of Project Gutenberg (an online library of over 60,000 free ebooks). If you find something you like and want to read more, the [i]entire[/i] book is only one click away--[i]and completely free![/i]
